title: Improve human-like web search and source summarization
measurement_note: Timing began after the first web searches and after Playwright close-out; early web search is partially represented.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Checked search-method, snowballing, systematic search, and source-evaluation references.

phases.label: Existing structure review
phases.bottleneck_notes: Reviewed source discovery, research profiles, source collector, workflows, and persistent instructions.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Added human search profile, source collector query-plan, workflow, prompt, policies, memory anchor, and requirements/spec artifacts.

phases.label: Documentation and history
phases.bottleneck_notes: Wrote web search records, research notes, request traces, work summaries, and evaluation inputs.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran source collector tests, query-plan smoke test, JSON/config/memory/docs/naming/structure/workspace checks, grounding, and work evaluation.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed after validation and evaluation records were prepared.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The largest current cost is cross-cutting governance updates across configs, workflows, prompts, docs, memory bootstrap, specs, and tool tests.
improvement_candidates: Use the new source collector query-plan command at the start of future broad searches.
Consider a future provider adapter only after repeated manual source collection shows a stable input format.
